West Bengal Politics: Key Leader Switches Allegiance Amidst Party Strife

Anubrata Mondal, considered a close aide of West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, has joined a faction led by Ritabrata Banerjee. This move comes as Ritabrata Banerjee's group announced district committee appointments, including Mondal as the Birbhum district president. The developments occur amidst heightened political activity, including a planned rally on July 21st, which has led to legal challenges.
